mmbu-paper.citation: D'Cunha et al., MMBU: A Massive Multi-modal Biomedical Understanding Benchmark to Probe the Perception Capabilities of Vision-Language Models, arXiv 2606.06696, 4 June 2026.
mmbu-paper.read: full text as saved on 2 October 2026
claims: The benchmark curates 410 public datasets; each question pairs a biomedical image with a task; the paper's words for context fields (for example X-ray, Light Microscopy, specimen Human).
mmbu-paper.does_not_prove: Anything about our models, or the hidden test set's contents.

mmbu-brief.short: The MMBU Challenge site and brief
mmbu-brief.citation: MMBU Challenge, organized by Stanford MARVL: challenge site and participant brief, read 2 to 9 October 2026.
claims: One model, one pass per question, no tools or retrieval; answer (T) and context (C) scored, S = 0.8T + 0.2C; Track 3 for small models (the web page: at most 4B active and 12B total parameters; the brief of 9 October: a 4B model, counted as 4.66 billion total parameters), scaled by (4.66e9 / P)^0.1; training sources disclosed; deadline 31 December 2026, 23:30 Pacific (the organisers' Discord answer of 3 October).
mmbu-brief.does_not_prove: How the organisers' judge scores a given reply, or the final leaderboard.

mmbu-organiser.citation: MMBU organiser answers on the challenge Discord, 3 to 14 October 2026, as recorded in our run notes.
claims: "All datasets are acceptable as long as disclosed" (9 October); the public dev questions are for evaluation only; the 4B limit counts the vision tower and the embeddings.

mmbu-prereg.citation: MMBU run records: train/PREREG.md and train/ft2 to ft8 PREREG-*.md, each fingerprinted into the prereg ledger.
claims: Each run names its comparison and bar before its result: a paired bootstrap (10,000 resamples, seed 20261002, percentile) on the public dev questions, lower bound above zero unless a non-inferiority margin is stated. Our answer scorer JP1 agreed with a blind re-grade of 180 earlier dev answers on 175, with no false accepts; the re-grade was done by the Claude session leading the work, the same model family as the official judge.
mmbu-prereg.n: 3,091 dev questions for FT5 to FT7; FT4 was decided on 3,102 and re-scored on 3,091.
mmbu-prereg.does_not_prove: That the files were written before the results; see the ledger source.

mmbu-ft4.citation: MMBU run records, train/ft4/bars_ft4_excl12.json (SHA-256 ca54d77a73c6); the run's preregistration, train/ft4/PREREG-FT4.md.
claims: FT4 added 20 public sources, 17 of them inferred MMBU sources (tier Q2) and 3 more (RIVA_PAP, DERM12345, FDG_PET_CT), plus 1,039 format copies: 29,421 rows. H1, dev answers FT4_4B minus FT3A_4B: -0.007 [-0.018, 0.004], not met (decided on 3,102 rows; the same verdict on 3,091 after the 12-row exclusion). The format copies arrived with the new sources, so the result cannot separate them.
mmbu-ft4.does_not_prove: That those sources could not help with a different recipe.

claims: K1, one more epoch from FT3A_4B over FT3A's rows plus the format copies: +0.001 [-0.007, 0.009], not met.
mmbu-ft5.does_not_prove: Anything about longer schedules or other learning rates.

mmbu-baselines.citation: MMBU run records, diag/baselines.json (SHA-256 d135ae4f7f0a); FT7_4B's dev answer score from train/ft7/bars_ft7.json (SHA-256 221bd716e8c9).
claims: Chance among the judge's options 0.2074; the most common answer per question family, left one out (an oracle the model cannot use), 0.2368; FT7_4B 0.2294 (JP1).
mmbu-baselines.does_not_prove: What the official judge would score.

claims: Real images 0.2087; mean-colour blank images 0.0819; real minus blank +0.127 [0.113, 0.141]; 74.7% of answers change.
mmbu-audit.does_not_prove: That the model uses the image well, only that it uses it.

mmbu-prior.short: Where the model loses to the oracle
claims: 51% of answers name no option; chest radiograph regions, 82 rows: model right 2 times, the oracle 40; surgical instrument tips, 54 rows: 7 against 31.
mmbu-prior.does_not_prove: Why the model words its answers off the option list.

mmbu-option.citation: MMBU run records, diag/option_readout_FT5_4B.json (SHA-256 6aca907696fe); the rule was fixed in ledger entry 64 before the run.
claims: FT5_4B on 2,654 single-label rows: its top-scored option right 0.414, its generated answer right 0.197, difference +0.217 [0.198, 0.236]; the rule chose answer-vocabulary rows. The readout calls the gap wording and label recall, partly inferred, since picking from a closed list is easier than open generation.
mmbu-option.does_not_prove: That option scoring could be used in the contest; it is an evaluation-only readout, since the rules allow one generated reply.

claims: M2, region-question answers, FT6_4B minus FT5_4B on 860 rows: +0.026 [0.008, 0.044], met; M5, Pass 2 replies valid 0.9984 against a bar of 0.999, not met; M6, 3,090 of 3,091 Pass 1 replies hold an answer, not met.
mmbu-ft6.interval: 95% paired bootstrap; Wilson intervals for rates.

mmbu-amend2.citation: MMBU run records, train/ft7/PREREG-FT7-AMENDMENT-2.md (SHA-256 a8663983c53b), ledger entry 79: signed 07:13:43Z on 16 October 2026, while FT7 was at step 20 and no FT7 output existed.
claims: The absolute format bars also rejected the standing candidate, FT3A_4B (Pass 2 valid 0.9958, 3,089 of 3,091). The new rule, for later runs: replace the candidate when every answer bar is met and the format is no worse than the candidate's.
mmbu-amend2.does_not_prove: The signing time, beyond our own record; see the ledger source.

claims: N4, adjusted S, FT7_4B minus FT3A_4B: +0.043 [0.035, 0.050], met; N5, held-out answers: +0.021 [0.007, 0.036] (non-inferiority, margin 0.02), met; FT7_4B became the candidate.

mmbu-vocab.citation: MMBU run records, train/heldout_vocab/heldout_vocab_ft7.json (SHA-256 6cb68387f23b); preregistration train/heldout_vocab/PREREG-HELDOUT-VOCAB.md; ledger entries 87 and 88.
claims: FT7 minus FT6 held-out context: -0.089 [-0.103, -0.076] under the sources' own labels, +0.152 [0.135, 0.172] under labels rewritten to the paper's words (light microscopy 400 rows, X-ray 150, ultrasound 101, specimen 250). Post hoc for FT6 and FT7; preregistered for FT8 only.
mmbu-vocab.does_not_prove: Which key is right; neither is neutral.

mmbu-survival.citation: MMBU status notes (STATUS-2026-10-15.md) and ledger entries 54, 73 to 76 and 84.
claims: Checkpoints every 50 steps; FT7 saved step 665 in 0.53 s on a shutdown and resumed about 6.2 hours later with no step lost; the FT5_4B init_lora crash idled the GPU about 10 hours; a duplicate trainer after an app restart cost 40 steps and about 30 minutes; the liveness check now fails closed; FT8 stopped at step 500 of 1,918 when the author paused the work on 16 October 2026.
mmbu-survival.does_not_prove: That no other failure mode remains.

mmbu-ledger.citation: HarperZ9/prereg-ledger, ATTESTATIONS.md, read with git on 17 October 2026: entries to 89 in the local file; the remote holds entries to 27, last pushed 4 October 2026; the repository is private.
claims: All 19 preregistration and amendment files match the ledger, 16 to a full SHA-256 and 3 to the 8-character prefix the ledger recorded (re-hashed 17 October 2026). Entries 28 to 89 were never committed or pushed, so no outside timestamp backs their order, and a file and its local fingerprint line could have been changed together.
mmbu-ledger.n: Entries numbered 1 to 89 (92 headings; the duplicates and a missing 36 are recorded in the ledger itself).

ns-recompute.citation: media/school/mmbu/facts.json, written by tools/school/fill_mmbu.mjs: numpy's SeedSequence, PCG64 and integers ported to JavaScript (system/school/mmbu-rng.mjs, checked against numpy), and the scorers' bootstraps re-run on the published per-row scores (media/school/mmbu/data/).
claims: K1, M1, N1, N3, N4, N5 and both held-out vocabulary intervals reproduce to the printed digits.
ns-recompute.n: 3,091 dev rows; 1,006 and 1,293 held-out rows in 732 clusters.
ns-recompute.does_not_prove: That the per-row scores are right; they come from our local scorers.
